about: Exceptions to the primary-fire blasts derived from the saved wiki weapon modules (PLAN G49 P2, pipeline/build/blasts.py: the AoE attacks whose AttackParentIndex is the scored attack, or that attack itself when it is AoE). `blasts`: WFCD attack names replacing the derived list ([] = none). `shot` (optional): the primary-fire attacks the primer fires when DE's numbers are another mode. `reason` says why the derived list is wrong for this gun.

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.name: Tenet Ferrox
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.reason: Radial Attack is the thrown spear's detonation (Spear Throw is the Semi alt fire); the charged shot is hit-scan with no blast. The module gives it no parent.

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpArSnip.name: Ambassador
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpArSnip.reason: Charged AoE is the Charge alt fire's blast (attacks 2-3); the scored Auto has none. The module gives it no parent.

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpBFG/Cr.name: Opticor
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpBFG/Cr.reason: The charged shot (the scored primary fire) ends in Charged Shot AoE; the module gives it no parent. Quick Shot AoE is the released-early shot.

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpBFG/Va.name: Opticor Vandal
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpBFG/Va.reason: The charged shot (the scored primary fire) ends in Charged Shot AoE; the module gives it no parent. Quick Shot AoE is the released-early shot.

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpSentEx.name: Battacor
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpSentEx.reason: The module parents Secondary Fire AoE to the primary attack, but it is the alt-fire's blast (attack 2 Secondary Fire, Trigger Auto-Charge); alt-fire blasts do not count (project decision 2026-11-13).

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/Spears/Ra.name: Ferrox
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/Spears/Ra.reason: Radial Attack is the thrown spear's detonation (Spear Throw is the Semi alt fire); the charged shot is hit-scan with no blast. The module gives it no parent.

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnCanno.name: Zarr
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnCanno.reason: The cannon shell's cluster bombs explode with it; the module parents only Cannon Mode Explosion. Barrage Mode is the other mode.

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerCr.name: Stug
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerCr.reason: Each blob bursts after it sticks; the module gives Blob Explosion no parent. Incarnon Form Bounce Explosion belongs to the Incarnon Form.

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfUzi/I.name: Zymos
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfUzi/I.reason: Headshot Explosion only happens on headshots; the primer scores body shots.

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/TnChoirBow/TnC.name: Evensong
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/TnChoirBow/TnC.reason: DE's numbers are the charged shot plus its radial (500 + 150 = 650); the module gives the radial no parent.

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTrumn.name: Trumna Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTrumn.reason: Every Auto shot bursts in Auto AoE; the module gives it no parent. The grenade is the Semi-Auto alt fire.

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistols/PrimeEpitap.name: Epitaph Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistols/PrimeEpitap.reason: DE's numbers are the charged shot; players prime with the uncharged primary fire (project decision 2026-11-13: the best primer; Priming:155 lists Epitaph (Primary Fire)).

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistols/TnWraitheSi.name: Epitaph
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistols/TnWraitheSi.reason: DE's numbers are the charged shot; players prime with the uncharged primary fire (project decision 2026-11-13: the best primer; Priming:155 lists Epitaph (Primary Fire)).

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/U18.name: Talons
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/U18.reason: Each throw explodes once: mid-flight (scored) or embedded, never both.

/Lotus/Weapons/Thanotech/ThanoRifle/Than.name: Trumna
/Lotus/Weapons/Thanotech/ThanoRifle/Than.reason: Every Auto shot bursts in Auto AoE; the module gives it no parent. The grenade is the Semi-Auto alt fire.
